description: This file contains unit tests for the DHT Grain Locator component in an Orleans-based distributed system. It verifies behavior such as grain unregistration and batch deactivation handling.

classes.name: DhtGrainLocatorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for the DhtGrainLocator component, testing registration and unregistration behaviors.

methods.description: Tests batch unregistration of multiple addresses with various causes.
